title: Scratch projects: only folders Maestro created, carrying its marker file, are listed, marked or deletable
story: Maestro writes a hidden marker file into every scratch project it makes, and only folders with that file count as scratch projects; before, every subfolder of the scratch folder counted. Real folders in a chosen scratch folder are no longer listed in the pill, get no flask mark and no Delete-or-keep question, and the backend refuses to delete them.

checks.criterion: A new scratch project holds the marker file
checks.steps: In eagle view press Ctrl+T, pick '+ New scratch project', accept 'scratch-qa-1', then open the scratch folder with hidden files shown.

checks.criterion: Unmarked subfolders are never listed, marked or asked about
checks.steps: Create C:\qa-scratch\real-work\note.txt and set the scratch folder to C:\qa-scratch. Open the pill. Open 'real-work' as a project, start and close a terminal, use Stop All, then close its tab.
checks.expected: The pill shows (0), no flask mark, no Delete-or-keep question, and note.txt is still there.

checks.criterion: A Maestro-made folder can still be deleted, even right after its terminals close
checks.steps: Make 'scratch-qa-2', start a terminal in it, close the tab and answer Delete; also try the pill's bin then Yes on another new project.
checks.expected: Each folder is gone with no error, and 'real-work' is untouched.
